content.text: /ext:medcp Across the past three years, how did monthly Clostridioides difficile infection diagnoses trend, and do months with higher CDI coincide with increased inpatient broad-spectrum antibiotic starts?
Let me first check what tables are available in the clinical database, then run the queries needed to answer this question.

arguments.sql_query:
-- CDI concepts: find them in concept/concept_ancestor to get all descendants of CD Clostridioides difficile
SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.standard_concept, c.vocabulary_id
FROM omop.concept c
WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%clostridioides difficile%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%c. difficile%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%claudia difficile%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%colitis clostridium difficile%'
LIMIT 50;

-- Broad spectrum antibiotics: penicillins with beta-lactamase inhibitors, third/fourth gen cephalosporins, carbapenems, fluoroquinolones
SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.standard_concept, c.vocabulary_id
FROM omop.concept c
WHERE (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%piperacillin-tazobactam%'
       OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%meropenem%'
       OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%imipenem%'
       OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ertapenem%'
       OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%daptomycin%'
       OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%vancomycin%')
   AND c.standard_concept = 'S'
LIMIT 30;
